subject: Urgent: Remora pilot bakeoff — intervention & capacity ask
messages:
From: Caroline Smith <caroline@remora.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot results and next steps

Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the pilot. We ran the internal benchmark this week and flagged two issues: (1) inference tail latency on long-prompts is ~40% higher than our expectations, and (2) token cost at our projected 1B/mo volume is materially above the incumbent vendor's quote.

We're starting a short bakeoff next week with two vendors. Procurement has asked for a mutual action plan and final commercial terms by EOD Friday so they can include it in the renewal packet. If Redwood can't hit the latency target or bow to a commercial bridge for 3 months, procurement will likely consolidate with the incumbent.

Can you share a specific save plan (bench changes + short term commercial) and confirm whether you can commit to an A/B test with persistent KV cache enabled?

-Caroline
Director of Infrastructure
Remora AI

Attachment: remora_benchmark_results_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Smith <caroline@remora.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot results and next steps

Caroline —

Really appreciate the candid note and the benchmark file. We've reviewed the results and agree there are two clear levers: runtime configuration (KV-prefetch, batching and short-seq scheduling) and a targeted short-term price adjustment while you validate at scale.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Operational A/B: We'll run an A/B where 10% of traffic uses a KV-persistent path + adjusted batching windows your team suggested — 5 business days to measure tail latency delta.
- Commercial bridge: 12% unit discount for the first 90 days on the committed volume (applied retroactively once annual renewal is signed).
- Mutual action plan: please find the attached MAP and a suggested timeline.

I want to loop in Ben for commercial finalization, Marissa for account coordination, and Rishi for a quick ops note on what we can flip in the runtime immediately.

Thanks — we'll prioritize this.

—Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Monica Patel | monica@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_DEAL-8742.xlsx (XLSX, 80KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot results and next steps — need pricing + ops play

Team — forwarding Caroline's benchmark summary. Short ask: can we lock the 12% 90-day bridge on committed ACV and confirm the A/B plan operationally? Procurement needs final language by Friday EOD.

Key constraints from the customer:
- They will evaluate both latency (tail P95-P99 on long-prompts) and effective unit cost at 1B tokens/mo.
- They prefer a 90-day trial window with the discount applied to the renewal invoice if they sign.
- They're running the bakeoff next Tue–Thu.

I'll be on the customer calls Wed and Thu. Ben — can you draft the contract amendment language? Marissa — can you prepare a conservative uplift forecast if they shift 20–50% of traffic? Rishi — what runtime toggles can we enable immediately without a full deploy?

Thanks —
Monica

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot results and next steps — need pricing + ops play

All —

I can commit to the 12% bridge on the first 90 days for the committed tier. Proposed contract language (draft):
"If Customer executes renewal within 30 days of the mutual action plan, Redwood will apply a 12% credit to unit token charges for the first 90 days post-renewal for the agreed committed volume (DEAL-8742)."

I want to preserve our standard overage terms; the credit applies only to committed units. Also attaching a quick ROI calc showing the discount impact at 1B tokens/mo and at a 40% shift scenario.

Attachment: redwood_discount_roi_DEAL-8742.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Ben
Senior Director, Revenue Operations

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot results and next steps — need pricing + ops play

Quick technical note for the A/B: we can flip KV-persistence and aggressive micro-batching on their dedicated pool without a new model build. Steps:
1) Enable KV-persistent mode on 10% of incoming sessions (route via policy flag). Estimated time: 24–36 hours to configure and validate.
2) Adjust batching windows for long sequences only; this reduces tail by expected 20–30% in our benchmarks but increases short-seq throughput slightly.
3) Instrument per-request tracing for P95/P99 and push to the shared dashboard (I will add charts).

Risk: enabling persistent KV will increase GPU memory pressure at 10% traffic — we should provision a small 10% burst headroom on the Dedicated pool. Ops cost estimate attached.

Rishi
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachment: runtime_ops_impact_estimate.docx (DOCX, 60KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Smith <caroline@remora.ai>, Procurement <procurement@remora.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot results and next steps

Caroline —

Thanks again for the benchmark file and the open feedback. Per our internal alignment, here is the agreed save plan for the Remora bakeoff and renewal packet: 

1) Operational A/B: Redwood will run a 5-business-day A/B starting Tue, May 26. 10% sessions routed to KV-persistent path + adjusted batching windows. Rishi will instrument P95/P99 charts and share a live dashboard link.

2) Commercial bridge: 12% credit applied to committed volume for the first 90 days post-renewal (language below). Credit will be applied if renewal is signed within 30 days after MAP completion.

3) Capacity buffer: Redwood will provision a 10% burst headroom on the Dedicated pool during the A/B window to avoid memory pressure. Ops cost for buffer will be absorbed by Redwood for the trial period.

4) Timeline & next steps: we attached the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short ROI note. Ben will circulate a one-paragraph contract amendment for procurement to review. Please confirm acceptance by EOD Monday so we can standby for the bakeoff next Tue.

Proposed contract clause (for procurement):
"If Customer executes renewal within 30 days of the completion of the Mutual Action Plan, Redwood will apply a 12% credit to unit token charges for the first 90 days post-renewal for the agreed committed volume under DEAL-8742. Redwood will provision a 10% capacity buffer for a 5-business-day A/B test at no additional charge."

We look forward to the bakeoff and will be on standby.

—Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_DEAL-8742.xlsx; remora_benchmark_results_v2.pdf; redwood_discount_roi_DEAL-8742.pdf; runtime_ops_impact_estimate.docx
